messages:
maria: heads-up — eu-west rack-r12 seeing 95th latency spikes on inference paths. nvml shows temps creeping into thermal-throttle range and NIC tx bursts at the same time. billing shows a big burst from prod-image-gen. any quick mitigations before we start moving allocations? :rotating_light:

infra-bot: Alert generated: eu-west-2 / rack-r12 / GPU temps >85C across 6 nodes; correlated egress burst >700mbit sustained for ~90s (09:12 UTC). Incident ID: IG-20260321-01

aj: ouch. are those shared slices or dedicated GPUs for that tenant?

maria: shared slices (fractional dedicated pool). here's the quick nvml trace i pulled (sampling each sec):
```
time,tempC,util_gpu,util_mem,proc_count
09:11:58,82,95,78,12
09:12:00,86,99,85,18
09:12:02,88,100,88,21
09:12:04,90,100,90,24
```

sasha: sounds like a thermal cascade + NIC saturation combo. quick mitigation: shape tenant egress + deprioritize their packets so we avoid PCIe stall/backpressure. short tc command to apply on their vport: 
```
# apply TBF to limit tenant egress to ~300mbit
tc qdisc replace dev vport-123 root tbf rate 300mbit burst 32k latency 50ms
```
should be safe to push via agent and rollback in <2m. :thinking_face:

leo: if we move them to a reserved warm slice it's more predictable but costs ~0.8k/day for the slice in eu-west. depends if product is okay with continued perf hit. tradeoff: cost vs immediate reliability.

asim: long term we should add a short-window noisy-neighbor ML detector: input telemetry (gpu temp delta, pci util, nic egress burst) -> score -> auto-soft-quiesce. we have enough labeled spikes from last 6 months to prototype.

ops-oncall: can quiesce the tenant's background batch jobs now for 5 mins to let temps drop. i'll coordinate with CS to notify the customer. doing staged quiesce (2 nodes at a time) to avoid mass cold start. :shipit:

aj: +1 to tc + staged quiesce. also can we add an emergency fast-fallback that pins noisy tenants to preemptible dedicated slices to stop cross-tenant impact? would need a fast-alloc path.

maria: plan: 1) sasha apply tc rule to vport-123 (now) 2) ops-oncall run staged quiesce 3) aj iterate on fast-fallback design and flag cost ledger impact 4) asim start a short ML prototype issue. i'll open a follow-up doc for cost/SLAs. tagging @sasha for the PR to infra-ops.

sasha: applying now. will post status.

infra-bot: Action log: tc rule pushed to vport-123 by sasha at 09:14:22 UTC; monitoring started.

maria: thanks team — please update the follow-up doc with any regressions. will keep this thread for post-mortem notes. :thumbsup:
